reviews.title: Really disappointed
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and posted a job but you can’t even message anyone without signing up. 1 month is $40, kind of high but if I can find quality care it would be worth it. I had 2 applications and 1 never responded and the other did a meet and greet and decided the location was too far. Not sure how she didn’t realize that when I gave her the address. I reached out to caregivers myself with no response. The app lacks people who are willing to work and in quality. I canceled my job, got it filled elsewhere and the app refuses to refund my $40 even though it was no help and actually costed me time. Do better Care .com

reviews.title: Horrible customer support
reviews.text: They ever charge me refused to give a refund. This is a horrible place. I would not suggest to use them.

reviews.title: Care.com Backup Care is completely unreliable
reviews.text: For a service that is supposed to help with childcare emergencies, Care.com Backup Care is just a dumpster fire. They rarely are able to find caregivers and most requests go unfulfilled.

reviews.title: Don't trust the reviews
reviews.text: I have hired several people from Care and even worked as a provider years ago. I can tell you that they allow anyone to provide services and they don't let you review a person twice. Many services will do their best the first time and then get lazy. Even myself when I was babysitting on there. So many of the reviews you see are not reflective of the experience over time like a Google review or Facebook review or weird of mouth would be. They also will auto bill you and keep the money, I've never worked with a company unwilling to refund you for a service they didn't render. Feels like they don't actually care about quality or use experience, hopefully something better comes to market.

reviews.title: Huge Disappointment
reviews.text: Honestly, I’m so disappointed with this app. I expected it to be helpful and make things easier, but instead, it’s been a frustrating experience. It shouldn’t be this difficult to use an app that’s supposed to help people find caregiving jobs and connect with families. It feels like more trouble than it’s worth, and I’m left wondering why it’s difficult to even contact support and or get a email or reply back from them.  People are coming to this app looking for real opportunities, and the experience should reflect that. Care.com seriously needs to do better because, as of right now, I can’t say I’d recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Horrible UI
reviews.text:
Why do I need to download an app to find out I need to download a different app to then log in to access the user interface which is just an API library to opens and in app web browser which has no cookie or profile transference that then requires me to LOG IN AGAIN!

The UI is clunky, poorly formatted, poorly sized for mobile. Somehow, you have created an on device application that is worse than your web browser application…

reviews.title: Misleading Pricing and Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text:
I would not recommend Care.com. Before paying for a membership, I entered my budget and was shown tutors who appeared affordable. After joining, I discovered that the advertised pricing was completely different from what providers actually charged.

One tutor was listed at $15/hour but sent me her actual rates of $45 to $100. Several people I contacted even told me they were incorrectly listed as providing childcare! 

I contacted numerous people, received very few responses, and never found a tutor.

When I requested a refund and provided screenshots proving the discrepancies, Care.com denied my request and then closed my support case, telling me to start over.

I paid $63.93 for a service that was not accurately represented. Extremely disappointing experience. I would not use this company again.

reviews.title: Poor candidates
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for almost 3 weeks now and haven’t found a suitable nanny. Either they don’t send references and CPR/First Aid documents or they fail to show up to the video interviews that they accept or they haven’t updated their profile with availability.

reviews.title: DO NOT USE THIS APP! DONT USE!
reviews.text:
Update: I was advised to contact this place because they claimed to want to make things right. Their response on here was just for show. Of course they DID NOTHING! Do not waste your time on this site or waste your time communicating with the representatives. They do not help or want to help at all. Site is full of people who flake or don’t respond after agreeing to jobs. 

First time using this app because I have a 17 month old. Had an agreement of pay, time and date with a woman on there for babysitting. She ends up no showing and not responding to my messages. Completely lost confidence and faith in this site and app altogether and to top it off the company refuses to give me a refund on all the money I paid to join. Don’t waste your money or time on this app when you have people like that pretending they’re gonna babysit and a company who refuses to make things right.

reviews.title: Worst app ever
reviews.text:
Run from this app. Never had such a hard time with an app. Redundant, I think I entered my kids in like 10 times and it still broke. Edit doesn’t work, modifications don’t work. Really one of the poorest app experiences of my life. Fire these devs today!

Nothing but mistakes every where in this app! I demand a refund! Seriously, nothing but improper data, misconfigured actions in every part of the app. This company has missed the mark here in a big way, wasted $ I will never get back. Shame on the product manager and devs.

1.) mis matched address and zip codes

2.) added kids and other info over and over and still asks for your info.

3.) Bedroom / bathrooms sizes mismatched. 

4.) when you book a job, you keep getting people trying to get it. We hired someone, then 20 people still applied and kept texting I’m available, it’s filled, you click a button that’s says hired, but the app doesn’t show the others and you get endless messages from period with your personal info. 

5.) edit profile, and some fields are perma locked, randomly, can’t change basic details.

6.) paying them is the only thing that Works perfect. 

We did find a babysitter, thankfully we don’t have use the app anymore but lost the $52 startup.

reviews.title: This app is a scam.
reviews.text:
App has you make a basic account, which takes forever, but that is not even functional whatsoever.

It wants 40$ a month just to respond or review messages to potential nannies.

Looking at the blanked out responses I can tell that it’s simply visualized as a phishing attempt to get me to subscribe for money.

(The app promised basic functionality, but that was a complete lie)

Welcome to pure capitalism.
Pay a month for nothing!
Should be called Careful.com

Good Bye.. - Uninstalling now.

reviews.title: Only useful to subscribers

reviews.title: Subscription renews at 2x higher rate than stated in App

reviews.title: Zero Accountability & service
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the quality of service and accountability on your platform. I pay for Care.com expecting reliable childcare support, but instead I’ve experienced wasted time, stress, and zero meaningful assistance from your company.

Recently, I hired a babysitter through your app. She worked with my family for only 2–3 weeks before suddenly quitting because she found a job closer to her house. What is frustrating is that she never mentioned the commute being an issue during interviews or trial days. Everything seemed “perfect” until she abruptly bailed.

This situation left my family in a very difficult position because I also have a job and depend on childcare reliability. Families invest time interviewing, scheduling trial days, onboarding caregivers, and adjusting their work schedules. When caregivers suddenly leave without proper notice, the impact is serious.

Care.com needs stronger policies and accountability measures for caregivers using the platform. If a babysitter accepts a position, there should be an expectation of professionalism and reasonable notice before leaving. At minimum, caregivers should not continue casually browsing for new jobs immediately after accepting one without transparency.

I also posted a new job request immediately after this happened, and the applicants I received were completely unprofessional. Many profiles seemed questionable, and several people never responded after initial contact. It honestly makes the platform feel

So I thought this would help.. not really sure why because when I was trying to BE a babysitter for this app, I had the worst experiences. reviews.title: I want a refund

reviews.title: Expensive and not helpful!
reviews.text:
You have to pay just to message people on this app, which is ridiculous considering how poor the quality is. The caregivers we found would schedule interviews, take our information, confirm the time, and then completely ghost. No call, no show, nothing.

There are zero consequences for this, so people can waste your time as much as they want. What exactly are you paying for? Because it is not reliability, accountability, or actual help.

Not to mention this is a safety issue. You are expected to share personal information just to interview someone for a very sensitive role, yet there is no accountability when they disappear. That is not a risk anyone should have to take.

This service is overpriced, frustrating, and full of people who do not follow through. Total waste of money. I wish I could give zero stars

Then when you send them a screenshot and confirmation of the cancellation, they don’t respond. They are just a bunch of dirtbags. I wish you good luck with your next lawsuit, “care” dot com

reviews.title: Accountant cancelled based on a false claim
reviews.text: We had a young woman come to our home to ‘interview’ for a nanny position. She ended up making a police report against us for ‘child abuse’ when my husband warned our granddaughter she’d ‘get a pinch’ if she didn’t stop throwing toys. A PINCH!!!!!  The police officer called. He was so annoyed that this was an abuse allegation but was doing his job by following up with us. He assured me this was IN NO WAY abuse & that legally in our state we can spank our own children- which we actually DO NOT DO!  The case was closed after a 5 minute conversation with the officer. Our account was closed simply based on this RIDICULOUS allegation of abuse. Instead of asking our side, Care.com closed our account & emailed any other prospective Nannie’s that they may want to reconsider interviewing with us. I worked as a Foster Care Worker with kids who had been removed for abuse/neglect- horrors that would shock most folks, so to be lumped in with that for the threat of a pinch on the bottom of a toy throwing toddler is insane, & wholly unbelievable & unacceptable. I appreciate wanting children safe- 100%, but follow up with the folks you cancel on who have ZERO recourse. Unfair. Unbalanced & malicious. If I could give minus 5 stars I would.

reviews.title: Silent Auto-Renewal, No Reminder, No Accountability
reviews.text:
Care.com renewed my subscription and charged me $60 without any advance notice or billing alert. I received no reminder that the subscription was about to renew and no real-time notification when the charge occurred.

This is a classic dark-pattern subscription tactic: rely on users forgetting to cancel, then hide behind “non-refundable” policies when they complain. While this may technically comply with terms, it fails basic expectations of transparency and customer care.

When I contacted support, they admitted no notification was sent — yet still refused a refund. That’s not customer service; it’s policy over people.

In today’s app ecosystem, renewal reminders are standard. Care.com’s decision not to provide them feels intentional, not accidental.

I strongly recommend anyone downloading this app to be extremely cautious, monitor their billing closely, or look for alternatives that respect users and communicate clearly.

Again, I cannot stand this app.
